allowed_private_runtime_plugins.purpose: Semantic mediation for explicit owner proactive quiet/resume and audible speech mute/unmute intent; proactive execution remains native N.E.K.O and audible output is enforced only at the managed native output boundary.
allowed_private_runtime_plugins.acceptance_gap: Live semantic quiet stopped unsolicited proactive delivery, but the owner could still hear TTS/native Realtime audio after explicitly requesting no audible speech and then sending a message.
